question: Which substances are assigned to the loci of the letter au and the visarga?
premises: Specific placements are made in syllabic loci.
The locus of au receives yellow pigment.
The locus of visarga receives orpiment.
inference: Yellow pigment should be placed in the locus of au and orpiment in the locus of visarga.
plain_english: One should place yellow pigment in the locus of the letter au, and orpiment in the locus of the visarga.
